title: Household Expenditure by Category in Four Countries (2023)
prompt: The pie chart below shows the percentage breakdown of average household expenditure across six categories in four countries (A, B, C, and D) in 2023. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作 Task 1 练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请根据饼图总结主要特征并进行比较；不要表达个人观点或解释原因。建议先识别占比最大和最小的类别，再比较不同国家之间的差异，并注意使用准确的百分比表达和比较结构。
